def _authority_material(
    sealed: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    workspace_id: str,
    run_id: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    artifact_digest = sealed["identity_lock_digest"]
    payload_digest = sha256_digest(sealed)
    subject = {
        "contract_version": "AresAuthorityMaterial.v3",
        "producer": "parzifal",
        "artifact_type": "identity_lock",
        "artifact_digest": artifact_digest,
        "payload_digest": payload_digest,
        "workspace_id": _text(workspace_id),
        "run_id": _text(run_id),
    }
    receipt = sha256_digest(subject).split(":", 1)[1][:32]
    authority = {
        "artifact_type": "identity_lock",
        "artifact_digest": artifact_digest,
        "payload_digest": payload_digest,
        "receipt_id": f"parzifal:identity_lock:{receipt}",
        "sealed_payload": sealed,
    }
    if set(authority) != _AUTHORITY_KEYS:
        raise AssertionError("Parzifal Ares authority shape drifted")
    return authority


def seal_ares_identity_authority(
    *,
    workspace_id: str,
    run_id: str,
    record_id: str,
    record_version: int,
    record_digest: str,
    identity_lock: Mapping[str, Any],
    master_sheet: Mapping[str, Any],
    cast_sheets: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate Parzifal identity and emit Ares authority material."""

    lock, master, cast = _validate_documents(
        workspace_id, run_id, identity_lock, master_sheet, cast_sheets
    )
    sealed = _sealed_identity(
        workspace_id=workspace_id,
        run_id=run_id,
        record_id=record_id,
        record_version=record_version,
        record_digest=record_digest,
        lock=lock,
        master=master,
        cast=cast,
    )
    return _authority_material(
        sealed,
        workspace_id=workspace_id,
        run_id=run_id,
    )
